description: An NTLM handshake recorded through the proxy. Its single-use tokens are not replayed: the challenge leg is dropped, the token is removed, and the script answers the host's challenge with host-scoped negotiate_any auth whose credentials come from the project secrets INTEGRATED_AUTH_USERNAME and INTEGRATED_AUTH_PASSWORD. With those configured, replay performs a fresh NTLM handshake naming the configured user. The request carries a promotion finding until the credentials are reviewed.
source: NTLM over HTTP (connection-bound challenge/response); VuGen web_set_user negotiates it at replay.
